Hello,

I saw your opening for a Visual Content Designer at Smilebird Health and was drawn to how your network manages operational workflows for doctor-partnered clinics.

In my current role at Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives and built reusable design templates that cut turnaround time for corporate communications. For example, my branding kit for AT Creation showcases foundational visual identity and brand consistency work, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Since this role is onsite in Nagpur where I am based, I would love to share how my background in layout and print production can support your patient-facing materials. Would you be open to a quick look at one of my case studies?

Ananya
